name: EEB 3550
title: Tropical Biology
description: Explores the ecology and evolution of tropical organisms. Examines the physical and biological processes that shape tropical forests with a focus on paleobiology, geography, species interactions, and adaptations. Emphasizes the link between theory and environmental challenges, and the opportunities for conservation of tropical ecosystems.
requirement_description: BIOL 1108 or BIOL 1110. Not open for credit to students who have passed EEB 3895 when offered as Tropical Ecology.
